template_descriptor.description: Path to JSON file containing descriptor of template.

source.description: Source file for the label generation.

target.description: Target output file for the generated labels.

instances_json.description: Path to JSON file containing array of instances (can be used in combination with --dataset-json).

instance_json.description: Path to JSON file containing values for single instance.

dataset_json.description: Path to folder containing JSON files for instances.

dataset_csv.description: Path to CSV file containing instances.

dataset_csv_format.description: Sets format for parsing CSV dataset (available options: Default, Excel, InformixUnload, InformixUnloadCsv, MySQL, PostgreSQLCsv, PostgreSQLText, RFC4180, TDF).

instance.description: Key of instance to be rendered.

paper_size.description: Width and height of the paper in mm, ie. 210 297 for A4 paper portrait.

label_offset.description: X and Y offset of the first label in mm, ie. 5 5.

label_delta.description: X and Y delta between labels in mm, ie. 5 5.

label_size.description: Width and height of label in mm, ie. 50 30.
